title: Синонимы to be — связочные глаголы
description: Чем заменить be, чтобы речь не звучала плоско.
contains: seem / appear / prove / turn out / remain / become / grow / feel / look / sound, оттенки значения и сочетаемость.
intro:
🔗 Тема: Синонимы to be — связочные глаголы и их оттенки вместо плоского be.

⏱ Сколько займет: 5-7 дней по 30 минут

🎯 После этой темы ты сможешь: заменять be точными связками (seem, become, remain, prove); различать become/get/go/turn/come; ставить прилагательное после связки; избегать калек типа feel myself.

sections.title: 🎯 Зачем эта тема
sections.html:
to be — это не один глагол, а целая семья функций. На C1 речь перестает быть плоской, когда ты вместо вечного is/was выбираешь точную связку: seem (кажется), become (становится), remain (остается), prove (оказывается). Замена be на связку — признак зрелой речи.

Что отличает C1-C2:

  • Оттенок впечатления: She seems tired вместо плоского She is tired.
  • Точный переход: get dark (разг.) vs become famous (нейтр.) vs go bad (к худшему).
  • Стилевая связка: The castle stands on the hill вместо is on.

Главное правило: после связки идет ПРИЛАГАТЕЛЬНОЕ, а не наречие (это и есть тест на связку): It sounds strange (не strangely).

Связь с другими темами C1: опирается на лексику высокого уровня (тема 17) и register (тема 16).

sections.title: 📖 Теория
sections.html:
У to be несколько ролей, и под каждую — свои заместители.

1. Связочные глаголы впечатления (seem / appear / look / sound…)

Соединяют подлежащее с прилагательным, но добавляют «кажется/воспринимается».

ГлаголОттенокПример
seemкажется (субъективное впечатление)She seems tired.
appearкажется (по внешним признакам, формальнее)He appears (to be) honest.
lookвыглядеть (визуально)You look great.
soundзвучать (на слух/по описанию)That sounds wrong.
feelощущатьсяThe water feels cold.
smellпахнутьIt smells delicious.
tasteбыть на вкусThe soup tastes salty.
⚠️ После этих глаголов — прилагательное, не наречие: It sounds strange (не strangely).

2. Связки «становиться» (become / get / go / turn / come / grow)

По-русски везде «становиться» — по-английски пять разных глаголов, не взаимозаменяемых.

ГлаголКогдаПример
becomeнейтрально, + прил./сущ.become rich, become a teacher
getразговорно, ТОЛЬКО + прил.get tired, get dark, get angry
goк ХУДШЕМУ / отклонениеgo blind, go bad, go bankrupt, go mad
turnвнезапно; + цвет; + возрастturn pale, turn red, turn 30
comeк ХОРОШЕМУ итогу (узкий набор)come true, come undone, come right
growмедленно, постепенно (книжно)grow old, grow accustomed to
  • get + существительное в значении «стать» — ошибка: He got a manager ❌ → He became a manager ✅
  • Устойчивые: come true, come loose, come naturally — только come, не become.

3. Связки итога (turn out / prove / end up / remain / stay / keep)

  • turn out — оказаться в итоге: It turned out (to be) false.
  • prove — оказаться (подтвердиться): The plan proved successful.
  • end up — в итоге оказаться: He ended up broke.
  • remain / stay / keep — оставаться в состоянии: She remained calm. Stay safe. Keep quiet.

4. Связки нахождения (stand / lie / sit / rest) — стилевая роскошь

Вместо плоского is on/in:

  • The house stands on a hill. (вертикально, о зданиях)
  • The village lies in a valley. (о местности, горизонтально)
  • The vase sits on the shelf. (компактно)
  • The decision rests with you. (покоится/зависит)

5. Связки существования (exist / occur / arise / lie)

Вместо there is:

  • Such problems still exist. / Errors occur frequently.
  • A question arises. (о проблемах/вопросах)
  • The problem lies in the budget. (заключается в)

6. get-passive — разговорная замена be в пассиве

get + V3 — динамичнее и часто о неожиданном/неприятном:

  • He got fired. They got married. It got broken.
  • Формально на письме — be (was dismissed); в речи о происшествии — get.

7. Двойная природа: связка vs действие

Многие из этих глаголов бывают и связкой, и обычным глаголом — и тогда меняется смысл:

  • He looked happy (связка) vs He looked at me (действие)
  • The soup tasted salty (связка) vs She tasted the soup (действие)
  • He appeared calm (казался) vs He appeared at the door (появился)

sections.title: 🎙 Как это видит носитель / Где палится русскоязычный
sections.html:
👁 Как это видит носитель

  • be — это прозрачный, пустой глагол. Когда нужен оттенок (впечатление, переход, длительность), носитель автоматически тянется к seem/become/remain.
  • После связки — прилагательное на автомате. Он чувствует: «это описание состояния, а не как делается действие».
  • get / become — разный регистр. get dark звучит естественно в речи, become dark — книжно и натянуто.
  • go — это «сигнал тревоги». Почти всегда негатив: go blind, go off, go mad. Исключение — цвет лица (go red).
  • stand/lie вместо is — это стиль. The castle stands on the hill звучит литературнее, чем is on.

⚠️ Где палится русскоязычный

Калька (как думаем по-русски)ОшибкаКак надо
«Чувствую себя плохо»I feel myself badI feel bad (без myself)
«Стать менеджером» через getHe got a managerHe became a manager
«Звучит странно» (наречие)It sounds strangelyIt sounds strange
«Стало темно»It became dark (натянуто)It got dark
«Мечта сбылась»The dream became trueThe dream came true
«Молоко испортилось»The milk became badThe milk went off / went bad
«Выгляжу хорошо» (здоров)I look well (= здоров, другое)I look good (хорошо выгляжу)
💡 Самая частая ловушка — feel myself: по-русски «чувствую себя», но I feel myself звучит двусмысленно. Правильно просто I feel tired / I feel sick.

sections.title: 🗣 Нарративные приемы носителей / Ошибки именно русскоязычных
sections.html:
🎬 Как носитель чувствует связочные глаголы

  • be — глагол-по-умолчанию, который носитель заменяет, когда хочет добавить оттенок. Seem добавляет субъективность, become — движение, remain — устойчивость; голый be остается, только когда оттенок не нужен.
  • После связки автоматически идет прилагательное. Носитель не задумывается — это структурный рефлекс, часть самого понятия «связка».
  • become/get/go/turn/come — не синонимы, а разные истории перехода. Get — разговорно и нейтрально к результату, go — почти всегда к худшему, come — к хорошему исходу в узком наборе фраз, turn — внезапно или про цвет/возраст.
  • get-passive — сигнал разговорности и неожиданности. He got fired звучит как случившееся, а was dismissed — как факт в отчете.
  • Стилевые связки (stand, lie, rest) — литературный регистр. Носитель выбирает их не из необходимости, а чтобы добавить тексту вес и образность.

⚠️ Ошибки именно русскоязычных

  • feel myself вместо feel. I feel myself bad → I feel bad (без myself — калька с русского).
  • Наречие после связки вместо прилагательного. It sounds strangely → It sounds strange.
  • get + существительное для «стать». He got a manager → He became a manager (get берет только прилагательное).
  • become там, где нужен go/come. The milk became bad / The dream became true → The milk went bad / The dream came true.
  • look well вместо look good. You look well today (о внешности) → You look good today (well — про здоровье).
  • Однообразный be вместо стилевой связки. The castle is on the hill (плоско) → The castle stands on the hill (образнее).
💡 Общий принцип C1: после связки — прилагательное, не наречие. become (нейтрально), get (разговорно, только + прил.), go (к худшему), come (к хорошему исходу), turn (внезапно/цвет/возраст) — не взаимозаменяемы. feel myself — калька, говори просто feel.

sections.title: 💡 Примеры с разбором
sections.html:
Замена be на связку

  • Плоско: The plan was good and it was successful.
  • Сильно: The plan seemed sound and proved successful.

Переход — точный глагол

  • It got dark (разг.). The leaves turned red. He went bald. Her dream came true.

Стилевая связка

  • The cathedral stands at the heart of the old town, and the answer lies in its history.

sections.title: ⚠️ Подводные камни
sections.html:
Ошибка 1. feel myself

❌ I feel myself tired.

✅ I feel tired.

Ошибка 2. Наречие после связки

❌ It sounds strangely. / You look greatly.

✅ It sounds strange. / You look great.

Ошибка 3. get + существительное для «стать»

❌ He got a doctor.

✅ He became a doctor.

Ошибка 4. become там, где нужен go/come

❌ The milk became bad. / The dream became true.

✅ The milk went bad. / The dream came true.

Ошибка 5. look well vs look good

❌ You look well today (если имелся в виду внешний вид)

✅ You look good today. (well = здоров, не «хорошо выглядишь»)

exercises.title: Исправь ошибку
exercises.html:
1. I feel myself fine.
  2. It sounds strangely.
  3. He got a manager last year.
  4. The dream became true.
  5. The milk became sour.
  6. You look greatly.
  7. He went a teacher after university.
  8. It became dark quickly.
  9. He feels himself confident.
  10. The plan proved as successful.
  11. They became married last June.
  12. The soup tastes deliciously.
  13. She looks wonderfully in that dress.
  14. The roses smell sweetly.
  15. The rumour turned true.
exercises.answers:
1. ❌ → ✅ I feel fine.
  2. ❌ → ✅ It sounds strange.
  3. ❌ → ✅ He became a manager last year.
  4. ❌ → ✅ The dream came true.
  5. ❌ → ✅ The milk went sour.
  6. ❌ → ✅ You look great.
  7. ❌ → ✅ He became a teacher after university. (go не берет существительное в значении «стать»)
  8. ❌ → ✅ It got dark quickly.
  9. ❌ → ✅ He feels confident.
  10. ❌ → ✅ The plan proved successful. (без as)
  11. ❌ → ✅ They got married last June.
  12. ❌ → ✅ The soup tastes delicious.
  13. ❌ → ✅ She looks wonderful in that dress. (прилагательное после связки)
  14. ❌ → ✅ The roses smell sweet.
  15. ❌ → ✅ The rumour turned out (to be) true / proved true. («оказалось» — turn out, а не turn)

exercises.title: Найди ВСЕ ошибки в тексте
exercises.html:
«I feel myself great today. The sun is shining, and the garden smells wonderfully. My neighbour got a doctor last year, and he looks very well in his new uniform. When I told him my dream became true, he sounded surprisingly. The soup my wife made tastes deliciously, but the milk in the fridge became bad. Our old house seems quietly at night. My son was waiting for an hour and got angrily. Later it became dark, and the street lights came on. My grandfather became blind years ago, yet he remains cheerfully. He went 90 last week, and he still feels himself young.»

(найди 15 ошибок)
exercises.answers:
Исправленный текст:

«I feel great today. The sun is shining, and the garden smells wonderful. My neighbour became a doctor last year, and he looks very good in his new uniform. When I told him my dream came true, he sounded surprised. The soup my wife made tastes delicious, but the milk in the fridge went bad. Our old house seems quiet at night. My son was waiting for an hour and got angry. Later it got dark, and the street lights came on. My grandfather went blind years ago, yet he remains cheerful. He turned 90 last week, and he still feels young.»

Ошибки (15):

  1. ❌ I feel myself great → ✅ I feel great (без myself — калька с «чувствую себя»)
  2. ❌ smells wonderfully → ✅ smells wonderful (прилагательное после связки)
  3. ❌ got a doctor → ✅ became a doctor (get не берет существительное)
  4. ❌ looks very well → ✅ looks very good (well — про здоровье, а тут внешний вид)
  5. ❌ dream became true → ✅ dream came true (устойчивое сочетание)
  6. ❌ sounded surprisingly → ✅ sounded surprised (прилагательное после связки)
  7. ❌ tastes deliciously → ✅ tastes delicious
  8. ❌ the milk became bad → ✅ the milk went bad / went off (порча — go)
  9. ❌ seems quietly → ✅ seems quiet
  10. ❌ got angrily → ✅ got angry
  11. ❌ it became dark → ✅ it got dark (became dark звучит натянуто)
  12. ❌ became blind → ✅ went blind (потеря здоровья — go)
  13. ❌ remains cheerfully → ✅ remains cheerful
  14. ❌ went 90 → ✅ turned 90 (возраст — turn)
  15. ❌ feels himself young → ✅ feels young (без himself)

exercises.title: Перепиши плоский текст со связками
exercises.html:
Улучши каждый фрагмент — замени повторы is/was точными связками.

  1. The town is quiet. The old church is in the square. The people are friendly. The food is good. Life is calm here.
  2. The house is empty. The garden is overgrown. The windows are dirty. The whole place is sad.
  3. She is nervous before exams. Her hands are cold. Her voice is shaky. Afterwards she is always fine.
  4. The soup is salty. The bread is fresh. The cheese is strong. The meal is excellent.
  5. He was a student. Then he was a teacher. Now he is a head of department.
  6. The problem is in the budget. The solution is in better planning. The decision is with the board.
  7. The mountain is behind the village. The river is below it. The view is spectacular.
  8. At first the plan was risky. Later it was successful. Now it is a model for others.
  9. The room is cold. The air is damp. The silence is heavy.
  10. My grandfather is old. He is still sharp. He is cheerful despite everything.
  11. The results were unclear. The data was incomplete. The conclusion was wrong.
  12. The city is on a river. The castle is on the hill. The market is in the centre.
  13. The milk is sour. The fruit is rotten. The whole fridge is a disaster.
  14. She was calm during the crisis. She is calm now. She will probably always be calm.
  15. The rumour was false. The truth was simpler. Everyone was relieved.
exercises.answers:
1. The town seems quiet. The old church stands in the square. The people appear friendly, and the food tastes wonderful. Life remains calm here.
  2. The house stands empty. The garden has grown wild, the windows look filthy, and the whole place feels forlorn.
  3. She gets nervous before exams. Her hands turn cold and her voice grows shaky. Afterwards she always feels fine.
  4. The soup tastes salty, the bread smells fresh and the cheese tastes strong. The meal proved excellent.
  5. He started as a student, then became a teacher, and has since risen to head of department.
  6. The problem lies in the budget, the solution lies in better planning, and the decision rests with the board.
  7. The mountain rises behind the village, the river lies below it, and the view looks spectacular.
  8. At first the plan seemed risky; later it proved successful, and it now stands as a model for others.
  9. The room feels cold, the air smells damp, and the silence seems heavy.
  10. My grandfather has grown old, yet he remains sharp and appears cheerful despite everything.
  11. The results seemed unclear, the data proved incomplete, and the conclusion turned out wrong.
  12. The city lies on a river, the castle stands on the hill, and the market sits in the centre.
  13. The milk has gone sour, the fruit has gone rotten — the whole fridge looks a disaster.
  14. She remained calm during the crisis, she stays calm now, and she will probably always seem calm.
  15. The rumour proved false, the truth turned out simpler, and everyone felt relieved.
